title.narrative: Energetische Sanierung einer Bildungseinrichtung für Kinder und Jugendliche in Albanien
Energy-efficient refurbishment of an educational centre for children and young people in Albania

description.narrative: As part of the planned measure, an education centre will be comprehensively renovated in terms of energy efficiency by installing a heat pump, ventilation system and photovoltaic system. This will enable the school centre to continue to fulfil its function as a model facility. Operating costs will be reduced and teaching conditions improved. The school consciously promotes access to high-quality education for particularly disadvantaged children and young people, for example from ethnic minorities.
